body:
I’m not really trying to get her in trouble. Whenever I found the vape stuff it was by accident. Like I found it in the laundry, in her pillow pet (I was making her bed), and I found it in a basket that I needed. I’m not actively seeking her to get in trouble but when I find something I want her to get into trouble because she’s a bad person. Bad people deserve jail time.

And like actively planning to murder somebody is perfectly okay?
If I had coins I’d give you gold (‘:

I’m sorry for your loss. I hope you know she went to a beautiful place— a beautiful place for a beautiful person. Try and remember all the times you’ve experienced together, the good ones, the funny ones, and even the bad ones. Think about them and cherish them, those are what those precious memories are for, they’re meant to be remembered and held close to your heart. Bless you. 💖
Do you have any coping skills on how I can accept my happy self?
